summary: Comprehensive responsive UI testing of Rang Mohor luxury e-commerce site across 3 viewports (390x844 mobile, 768x1024 tablet, 1920x1080 desktop). All pages verified — no horizontal overflow on any page at any breakpoint. Header/nav/menu/bento/grid/footer/dark-mode all behave per spec.

responsive_verification.horizontal_overflow: PASS - scrollWidth == innerWidth on / /shop /cart /checkout /profile /auth at 390, 768, 1920 widths

mobile_390.header: PASS - mobile-menu-btn visible, LOGIN hidden, desktop nav 0 visible links
mobile_390.hero_heading: PASS - 'Elegant Wedding Return Gifts for Every Celebration' at 48px, width 342px within 390px viewport, no overflow
mobile_390.hero_buttons: PASS - SHOP NOW + EXPLORE CATEGORIES stack vertically
mobile_390.shop_grid: PASS - 2 columns (159px + 159px), filters collapsible, sort visible
mobile_390.product_detail: PASS - image stacks above info, thumbnails column 80px, ADD TO CART & BUY NOW both 342px wide (no overflow), reviews stacked
mobile_390.cart: PASS - empty state renders single column
mobile_390.checkout: PASS - form stacks single column, place order button full-width
mobile_390.footer: PASS - 4 columns collapse to 1 column (grid-template-columns: 342px, 4 children stacked)

tablet_768.header: PASS - mobile-menu-btn still visible (hidden lg:flex), LOGIN visible per md:inline-flex, desktop nav hidden until lg (0 links)
tablet_768.product_detail: PASS - single column main grid at md (720px), thumbnails col 80px, image 624px — no overlap
tablet_768.checkout: PASS - stacks vertically, form full width

desktop_1920.header: PASS - full nav (Home/Shop/Categories/About/Contact) + LOGIN visible + all icons
desktop_1920.bento_asymmetric_layout: PASS - col-span-8, col-span-4, col-span-4, col-span-4, col-span-4, col-span-12 (tetris layout as designed)
desktop_1920.grids: PASS - shop/PDP/cart/checkout use expected multi-column layouts

responsive_verification.dark_mode: PASS - toggle adds 'dark' class to html, body bg becomes rgb(21,14,17); text remains readable; verified at 1920px, appears in header at all breakpoints

context_for_next_testing_agent: Responsive layout is solid across all breakpoints. Home/Shop/PDP/Cart/Checkout/Profile/Auth/Footer all verified. Mobile menu drawer opens correctly. Bento grid uses correct asymmetric col-spans on desktop. Dark mode works. No overflow issues detected anywhere.
